description.value: The Kootenay Bakery Cafe Cooperative is a worker-owned organic bakery and café on Nelson's main commercial street, producing over 300 from-scratch products using certified organic and locally sourced ingredients. As a cooperative, it embeds principles of mutual aid and sustainability into its operations, supplying restaurants and retailers across the Kootenays alongside its café trade. Touring cyclists will find fresh breads, pastries, coffee, and warm beverages, with options for vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, and egg-free diets.
